_comment: Marco's trade (docs/PHASE4.md, step 4). Prices are in units of one bandage's worth (DESIGN.md anchors every price to wound care, and a bandage is this game's wound care before Doc); `unit` is that in satoshis. catalog: what he sells, a lot at a time, before M3 (no guns or ammunition). value: what he pays for one of an item is half its value (DESIGN.md A3: sell = 0.5x). Every catalogue item has its own (low) resale value, so nothing he sells can be made cheaply and sold back at a profit. Live animals are not bought: the farm flock is finite but regrows. Saves store item names.
